text: As its meeting on June 20, 2018, the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee considered a presentation from the Manager, Public Appointments, City Clerk's Office on City of Toronto Public Appointments.

The Executive Committee: 1. Requested the City Clerk, in consultation with the City Manager, to review, as early as possible, the candidate qualifications for Agencies and Corporations contained in the Public Appointments Policy, with the goal of reducing barriers and increasing participation of persons with disabilities in the qualified pool for consideration in the civic appointment process. 2. Requested the City Clerk to organize a special information session targeted to the widest possible disability community, as a means of outreach and recruitment to increase representation of persons with disabilities, as early as possible in the 2018-2022 City of Toronto appointments process.
